title: Q-METRIC-K: k 0.0 vs >= 1.0; lever ship-verified-deploy
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** metric loop pass: k outside its healthy condition
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation metricloop --probe k
**Status:** open

Metric `k` (target) reads 0.0; healthy is >= 1.0. Criticality: verified deploys per unit of cost plus human touches over 24 hours (foundation/criticality.py).
Lever now: **ship-verified-deploy**: Take the top raises-deploys item and ship it through deploy/deploy-workers.mjs so ops/deploys.jsonl gains a row with live_matches_commit true.
The loop judges this lever after the efficacy window; a lever that did not move the metric is replaced here, not repeated.

size: S
